hub.releaseNotes:
Ordrili 1.6.14
- Drinks on the menu: Dish/Drink items with brand and sizes ("Pepsi · 33 cl"), an Import drinks catalog with photos and prices per size; the drink's category is added from the pick.
- Built-in categories are managed by Ordrili; Water and Energy drinks added.
- Auto-print has a real on/off switch: off means nothing prints, on brings your last pick back.
- Notifications stack in the corner and say which order changed and how ("Order #7 · Table 12 — Now Served").
- Paid refunds and wasted food: refunds mark orders Refunded, the kitchen question on cancel/edit, a Wasted card on Profit.
- Order details redesign, Settings sub-navigation, and draft/paused items that read as not live.
- Printer-mode kitchen: rounds, UPDATED and CANCELLED tickets on the Hub printer; Spot stays quiet when the Hub prints.
- Kiosk and tablet attract screens carry the restaurant's brand; restaurant phone on the profile; QA fixes across orders, payments and rounds.
